shared_fragments.text:
## Deductive necessity is the foundational standard

[Ren’s explicit answer](../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-foundation-deductive-necessity.md) settles a previously open completion question. Earlier passages permitting direct evidence as a ground retain their evidential meaning; earlier objections to imposing an unrequested deductive gate are superseded for this task. The two permissive commitments—consequential differentiation and composability—have actual support, but their deductive foundational warrant is not thereby finished. The common constitutive process law also remains unproved at that strength.

The [new assessment](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/DEDUCTIVE-FOUNDATION-TEST.md) proves exact conditions for uniform promotion of actuality to necessity or necessary possibility. Five new Lean theorems and seven declaration audits pass with empty axiom dependencies. These are deductions about a supplied comparison relation, whose application and scope remain explicit. Modal return does not mean physical reversibility, and an all-predicate inference criterion is not imposed on an individual claim.

**尚待完成的是构成关系及其可能性范围自身的演绎根据。** Actual evidence, necessary implications and empty axiom reports each retain their scope; none is relabeled as the completed assumption-free foundation. Neither universal impossibility nor cancellation of the separate ethical route is asserted.

## Deductive standard for the independent assumption-free task

[Ren’s clarification](../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-foundation-deductive-necessity.md) requires every foundational claim in this task to be deductively necessary. It supersedes counting ordinary actual support alone as completion of the permissive root commitments, while preserving that evidence and all completed conditional results. The [new inference assessment](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/DEDUCTIVE-FOUNDATION-TEST.md) adds five checked Lean theorems / seven empty audits and identifies the exact conditions of two uniform actuality-to-necessity routes.

The necessary modal/constitutive warrant remains unresolved for the intended real scope. A supplied symmetric comparison relation or a law embedded in “complete organization” does not discharge it. **经验根据仍成立；根基的演绎必然性仍待建立。** The independent G0/J route remains authorized, and no requirement of perpetual survival, universal determinism or deduction of contingent measurements is added.

**Later scope clarification, 8 October 2026:** [Ren now explicitly requires deductive necessity](../../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-foundation-deductive-necessity.md) for every foundational claim. The actual warrant and constitutive arguments below retain their stated results; their empirical support alone does not complete a foundational commitment under that criterion. Read the [deductive continuation](DEDUCTIVE-FOUNDATION-TEST.md) for the current completion assessment. This amendment does not extend the earlier independent review to the new results.

**Later scope clarification, 8 October 2026:** [Ren explicitly selects deductive necessity](../../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-foundation-deductive-necessity.md) for every foundational claim. Passages below rejecting an unrequested deductivist gate are historical; that gate is now requested for this independent task. Direct grounds and construction retain their actual scopes. The [deductive continuation](DEDUCTIVE-FOUNDATION-TEST.md) does not count empirical support alone as foundational completion.

**根基的演绎标准 / Deductive foundational standard，2026-10-08。** C01 成对接入[当前标准与实查](DEDUCTIVE-FOUNDATION-TEST.md)：5项新定理／7项空依赖审计；经验根据不独自完成根基。/ Only C01, one owned discovery page and five fully read owned source versions are updated. Shared files receive owned insertions; earlier results, unrelated rows and pending concurrent reviews remain preserved. [Owned edits](DEDUCTIVE-FOUNDATION-INDEX-EDITS.json); [scoped checks](DEDUCTIVE-FOUNDATION-CHECKS.json). No new independent-agent acceptance or whole-table certification.

row_before.title_zh: 同一生成展开与关系分化
row_before.title_en: One generative unfolding and relational differentiation
row_before.claim_zh: 活动形成并转化后续活动的条件；组织、认识、行动与评价在同一展开中分化，并通过实际相连的机制及其对应得到说明。 系统通过实际关系辨认，边界须保留相关依存；预测充分性与构成参与分别说明。
row_before.claim_en: Activity forms and transforms conditions of further activity; organization, knowing, action and evaluation differentiate within one unfolding and are explained through connected mechanisms and their correspondence. Systems are identified through actual relations; boundaries retain relevant dependencies, with predictive sufficiency distinguished from constitutive participation.
row_before.scope_zh: 相连说明在条件范围内已完成；无假设目标继续。既有11项有限重演定理之外，持续阶段25项新定理、27项声明审计；构成可证源对应并传递至复合项，实际适用、逻辑／识别根据与普遍范围仍待证成。 直接构成论证保留已辨认关系的必要内容，排除同一架构普遍实现的额外门槛；全目标域的归属与覆盖尚未证成。本轮无新定理。 后续系统研究新增27项定理／41项空依赖声明审计，另18项继承审计：联合可接纳域中两个充分区域可以没有最小共同支持。最小性限可判定子区域，无最小支持结论不限。形成域内的有限词可行性已证；实际构成及更强普遍根据仍开放。 变化根据接续新增19项定理／21项空审计，59项继承声明原样复查：由形成与后续路径导出精确可达域及有限接续对应。发生、当前能力、普遍约束与精确范围各需相应覆盖；本地域输入已消除，实际普遍无假设根据仍未完成。 本轮一般论证澄清：实际参与及“可以发生”已有根据；相容共同实现具有一般构成约束力。必要构成条件尚不独自提供形成、转化及可能性变化的普遍充分说明。无新定理或公理；不要求所有具体应用无误，较强目标仍未完成。 内在分化路线的原文检验进一步保留实际作用与比较关系，拒绝将共同呈现直接升级为普遍必然自我展开；无新公理或定理，作者反审不冒充独立验收。
row_before.scope_en: Connected articulation complete at conditional scope; assumption-free grounding continues. Beyond 11 earlier finite-replay theorems, the sustained investigation has 25 new theorems and 27 audits. Construction can prove source links and propagate correspondence; actual applicability, logical/recognitional warrant and universal scope remain open. The direct constitutive argument preserves established relational content and rejects universal use of one architecture as an extra gate; full-scope attribution and coverage remain unestablished. No new theorem in this assessment. The subsequent systems study adds 27 theorems / 41 empty declaration audits plus 18 inherited audits: joint admissibility can allow two sufficient regions with no least support. Minimality is among decidable subregions; absence of a least support is unrestricted. Formed-domain finite-word feasibility is proved; actual constitution and stronger universal warrant remain open. The variation-warrant continuation adds 19 theorems / 21 empty audits, retaining 59 inherited audits: formation histories derive the exact attained domain and finite continuation correspondence. Occurrence, current capability, universal constraints and exact ranges need different coverage. The independent local domain input is removed; actual universal assumption-free warrant remains unfinished. The general argument now credits actual participation and permissive existence, and earns compatible joint realization as a general constitutive constraint. Necessary realization alone does not supply the common sufficient explanation of formation, transformation and changing possibilities. No new theorem or axiom; infallibility of every application is not required, and the stronger target remains unfinished. A primary-source test of immanent differentiation preserves actual operation while distinguishing comparison from causal scope; shared presentation does not alone establish universal necessary self-development. No new axiom or theorem; author counterreview is not independent acceptance.
